initialReview:
# Mobile Desk layout and stat-truth audit — 2026-10-22

Scope: a fresh S119 audit of the current worktree after S118's production release. The Genius queue was empty. Every premise below was measured against live code or a live browser, not inherited from the board.

## Findings and selected outcomes

| Rank | Tier | Category | Finding and implementation | Effort | Impact | Innovation | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | P0 | UI / mobile | The long-recorded "expanded-mobile Desk/card right-edge clipping" has one cause: `.team-mode-switch { width: max-content }` inside the situational-calls card. Grid intrinsic sizing cannot resolve `max-width: 100%`, so the switch's single-row width (326 px) becomes the column minimum and pushes every Desk card to x 391 on a 390 px phone. Let the switch shrink-wrap and wrap. | 1.5h | 8 | 5 | Desk cards inside the panel at 390 and 320 px; spec red on the old rule. |
| 2 | P0 | Simulation truth | `passerRating` in the stat schema and its client copy clamp the yards term before scaling it; the box score does it correctly. A 300/450, 3,500-yard, 25 TD, 10 INT season reads 89.3 instead of 99.3, and a perfect line caps at 147.4. One formula, reference-value contract, attributed golden-master change. | 2h | 8 | 4 | 99.3 / 158.3 / 0 / 39.6 from every call site; golden diff confined to stat sections. |
| 3 | P2 | Truth | The carried 16.2 MB payload regression measures 15.3 MB now; close it with the number and keep the 4.3% headroom visible. | 0.25h | 4 | 2 | Board closed with measurement; compaction deferred. |

## Nine-axis assessment

Features/depth: no new feature; correctness of an existing stat a GM reads every week. UI/UX: the phone Desk is the first screen of every week and it was clipped. Feedback: two different ratings for the same QB contradict the box score. Engagement: trustworthy numbers are the game. Intelligence: none needed. Security: CSS and pure-function changes only; no new input. Speed: no runtime cost. Token/cost: none. Competitive context: no market claims.
